paper.title_en: Near-Horizon BMS Symmetry and Implications on Black Hole Entropy
paper.abstract_en: Thermodynamic significance of near-horizon symmetries remains an important open question in black hole physics, particularly in the context of black hole evaporation and information recovery. In this work, we investigate the role of horizon-adapted Bondi-van der Burg-Metzner-Sachs (BMS)-like supertranslations in the thermodynamic description of a dynamical Schwarzschild black hole. Working in a near-horizon Rindler coordinate system, we construct a class of diffeomorphisms that preserve the horizon structure and promote the associated supertranslation parameter to a Goldstone-like mode arising from the breaking of horizon symmetry. By expanding the Einstein-Hilbert action around the background geometry, we obtain the effective action for the Goldstone mode and identify the corresponding conserved horizon charge from the surface contribution of the action. The relevant horizon is defined at the future outer trapping horizon, while the surface gravity is computed using the Kodama-vector construction appropriate for dynamical spacetimes. We show that the horizon supertranslation mode contributes non-trivially to the surface gravity and modifies the thermodynamic description of the black hole beyond the stationary limit. Using the associated Noether charge, we derive the entropy of the horizon-BMS transformed geometry and find that the Bekenstein-Hawking area law is recovered at leading order, while subleading corrections depend explicitly on the supertranslation sector and the dynamical evolution of the black hole.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文探讨视界BMS对称性及其对黑洞熵的影响，主题与黑洞热力学高度相关，理论上深入，方法上显然严谨，且具有新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 近视界BMS对称性及其对黑洞熵的影响
decision.abstract_zh: 近视界对称性的热力学意义仍然是黑洞物理学中的一个重要开放问题，特别是在黑洞蒸发和信息恢复的背景下。在这项工作中，我们研究了视界适配的Bondi-van der Burg-Metzner-Sachs（BMS）类超平移在动力学Schwarzschild黑洞的热力学描述中的作用。在近视界Rindler坐标系中，我们构造了一类保持视界结构的微分同胚，并将关联的超平移参数提升为由于视界对称性破缺而产生的Goldstone-like模式。通过在背景几何周围展开Einstein-Hilbert作用量，我们得到了Goldstone模式的有效作用量，并从作用量的表面贡献中识别出相应的守恒视界荷。相关的视界定义在未来外 trapping 视界处，而表面引力使用适用于动力学时空的Kodama矢量构建来计算。我们表明，视界超平移模式对表面引力有非平凡贡献，并修改了黑洞在静止极限之外的热力学描述。利用关联的Noether荷，我们推导了视界BMS变换几何的熵，并发现Bekenstein-Hawking面积定律在领头阶恢复，而次领头修正明确依赖于超平移扇区和黑洞的动力学演化。
